techniques.name: Hypothesis tree
techniques.purpose: Splits a claim into the sub-claims that must all be true for it to be true and produces a tree of claims that goes into a claims register.

techniques.name: Preprocessing sensitivity testing
techniques.purpose: Convert raw text into countable units and re-run the main result under several defensible cleaning regimes, giving cleaned text, a document-term matrix, a rule log and a sensitivity result.
techniques.added: MM-10 needs cleaned dataset:cleaned; alternatives: PE-03

techniques.name: Comparative case study
techniques.purpose: Examines a small number of cases with the same questions for each, producing a case by case matrix that shows consistent patterns and deviant cases.

techniques.name: Reflexive thematic analysis
techniques.purpose: Identifies and interprets patterns of meaning across qualitative data in six phases and produces themes with supporting extracts.

techniques.name: Framework analysis
techniques.purpose: Sorts coded qualitative data into a case by theme matrix and produces the matrix for reading across cases and themes.

techniques.name: Content analysis
techniques.purpose: Codes text into categories, then counts or interprets category use, and produces category frequencies or a category structure.

techniques.name: Stance detection
techniques.purpose: Label whether each text favours, opposes or is neutral toward a named target and produce a stance label per text and target.

techniques.name: Analysis of competing hypotheses
techniques.purpose: Lists plausible hypotheses, rates each evidence item against each, and produces a hypothesis by evidence matrix aimed at disproving hypotheses.

techniques.name: Source-span and quotation check by code
techniques.purpose: Require each extracted statement to point to the exact passage it came from, confirm by string match that the passage exists, and produce a pass or fail list per statement.

techniques.name: Disconfirmation search
techniques.purpose: Looks for evidence that would contradict a favoured claim and produces a list of refuting evidence found or not found with the search used.

techniques.name: Sensitivity analysis
techniques.purpose: Re-runs an analysis under different assumptions or inclusion rules and produces a table of results by assumption showing whether the conclusion reverses.
